Hi Ryan / ApexCare team —

Congrats again on getting the SOW across the finish line. Per our conversation on Friday, attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) that embeds the post-signature implementation steps into a single view: rollout windows, canary schedule, migration slices, training weeks, acceptance gates, and the quick-fallback plan.

High-level asks from our side in this email:
- Confirm the three-week pilot window (Week 1: Canary, Week 2: Expansion, Week 3: Final cutover) is acceptable for your teams.
- Identify the single technical POC for MyHealthOps and the security contact for SOC2 evidence exchange.
- Share any blackout dates for production traffic in October/November.

Attachments: ApexCare_MAP_v1.xlsx (live MAP), Canary-Test-Checklist.docx (detailed canary runbook), SOW signed (for reference).

Notes on risk & fallbacks: the MAP includes a staged rollback plan per slice (traffic-steering back to blue pool + data retention snapshot). Monica will own the training schedule and acceptance signoffs; Marissa will run the canary gates and monitoring.

Proposed next step: 30-minute align on Wed 10/1 to lock down POCs and the pilot start date. I’ve tentatively penciled 10/1 11:00 PT — does that work?

Thanks,
Avery

Added a few operational checkpoints into the MAP:
- Canary acceptance metric: p50 latency <= 180ms and error rate < 0.5% for two consecutive 6-hour windows.
- Rollback trigger: any sustained spike >1% error rate for 30 minutes or a regression in pairing tests.
- Monitoring hooks: integrated tracing dashboard (console link in MAP) and a short list of synthetic prompts for quality monitoring.

I also mapped the training slots: two 90-minute sessions (admin + developer) the week before pilot start, plus recorded modules for the broader ops team. Monica, please confirm you can host the sessions and supply slide deck.

Marissa
